# Holiday: how many days do I get, and what are they worth?

> Free UK holiday entitlement calculator: 5.6 weeks pro-rated for part-time, starters and leavers, plus the 12.07% method for irregular hours, and what unused days are worth. Runs in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
